pages.text: You may find that you need fine control over the torque and speed output. A gearbox can help you achieve this, by allowing you to exchange torque for speed or vice versa. $(p)Gearboxes work by leveraging mechanical advantage, which means they cannot produce or consume power, but only change the distribution of speed and torque for a given input power.
To use a gearbox, add two gears to it by $(k:use)ing the gearbox while holding a gear. The larger face is the input, and the smaller face is the output.
